description: Use this when the user has a company domain, a website or a work email address and wants to know the company behind it, for example "which company is behind doctolib.fr?", "how big and how old is the company at stripe.com?" or "who is the legal entity for the lead that wrote from jane@acme.io?". Pass the domain. Returns the legal name, country, registration number, a size band and the age of the company, each with a source link, the day it was read and a confidence of confirmed, name_match, printed_on_site or wikidata_only. A fact that could not be found is listed under unknown with the reason, never guessed. Companies only: free mail providers and free subdomains give no company, sole proprietors are left out, and no person, owner or employee is named. Do not use it for a person, for credit or risk, or for a company that has no public record.

domain.description: The company's domain, such as stripe.com. A web address or a work email address also works; only the part after the @ is used.
